Shorts with high average view percentages (above 65%) such as the Nuclear Submarines and Jet Engines teaser struggle with low initial reach if the topic or title lacks broad immediate appeal.
Long-form videos currently suffer from very low views and low retention (under 38%), indicating that the audience format preference leans heavily towards Shorts.
Audience drop-off in Shorts frequently happens within the first few seconds (e.g., Tesla Roadster drops 6.3% at 4.8s), indicating that hooks need tighter scripting.
Engagement metrics like comments are consistently zero across almost all videos, suggesting that explicit calls-to-action or end questions are currently ineffective or missing.
